passive.name: Unfulfilled Yearning
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **18/21/24/27/30%** and increases their Max HP by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When the wearer is attacked or consumes their own HP, their DMG increases by **24/28/32/36/40%**. This effect is removed after the wearer uses an attack.

weapons.name: Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path

passive.name: Vista
passive.text:
Increases the wearer's Max HP by **18/21/24/27/30%** and Incoming Healing by **20/25/30/35/40%**. When using Skill or Ultimate, consumes HP equal to **6/6.5/7/7.5/8%** of the wearer's Max HP and increases the DMG dealt by this attack by **30/35/40/45/50%**. If this effect's consumed HP is greater than **500**, the DMG additionally increases by **30/35/40/45/50%**.
If the current HP is not sufficient, this effect reduces the wearer's current HP down to 1.

passive.name: Spare No Effort
passive.text: Increases DMG dealt by the wearer by **20/25/30/35/40%**. The wearer also deals an extra **20/25/30/35/40%** of DMG to enemies whose current HP percentage is equal to or higher than the wearer's current HP percentage.

passive.name: Massacre
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. The Skill DMG and Ultimate DMG dealt by the wearer increase by **24/28/32/36/40%**.

passive.name: Curtains Up!
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Max HP by **12/15/18/21/24%**. When losing or restoring this unit's HP, increases CRIT DMG by **18/22.5/27/31.5/36%**, lasting for **2** turn(s). This effect can only trigger once per turn.

passive.name: Deflagration
passive.text: When the wearer's cumulative HP loss during one attack exceeds **25%** of their Max HP, or if the amount of their own HP consumed at one time is greater than **25%** of their Max HP, immediately heals the wearer for **15%** of their Max HP, and at the same time, increases the DMG they deal by **25/31.25/37.5/43.75/50%** for **2** turn(s). This effect can only be triggered once every **3** turn(s).

substatLine: SPD (Until Desired Breakpoint) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > HP%
tracePriority: Cyclone of Destruction (A6) > Neverending Deaths (A4) > Vita Infinita (A2)

entries.name: Shard Sword
entries.text: Deals **100%** of Blade's ATK as Wind DMG to a target enemy.

entries.name: Forest of Swords
entries.text:
Consumes HP equal to **10%** of Blade's Max HP and deals Wind DMG equal to the sum of **40%** of his ATK and **100%** of his Max HP to one designated enemy. In addition, deals Wind DMG equal to the sum of **16%** of Blade's ATK and **40%** of his Max HP to adjacent targets.
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when using "Forest of Swords."
"Forest of Swords" cannot regenerate Skill Points.

entries.name: Hellscape
entries.text:
Consumes HP equal to **30%** of Blade's Max HP to enter the Hellscape state.
When Hellscape is active, his Skill cannot be used, his DMG dealt increases by **40%**, and his Basic ATK Shard Sword is enhanced to Forest of Swords for **3** turn(s).
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses his Skill.
This Skill does not regenerate Energy. Using this Skill does not end the current turn.

entries.name: Death Sentence
entries.text:
Sets Blade's current HP to 50% of his Max HP and deals Wind DMG to one enemy equal to the sum of **40%** of his ATK, **100%** of his Max HP, and **100%** of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle. At the same time, deals Wind DMG to adjacent targets equal to the sum of **16%** of his ATK, **40%** of his Max HP, and **40%** of the tally of his HP loss in the current battle.
The tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at **90%** of his Max HP. This value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.

entries.name: Shuhu's Gift
entries.text:
When Blade sustains DMG or consumes his HP, he gains 1 stack of Charge, stacking up to 5 times. A max of 1 Charge stack can be gained every time he is attacked.
When Charge stack reaches maximum, immediately launches a Follow-Up ATK on all enemies, dealing Wind DMG equal to **44%** of Blade's ATK plus **110%** of his Max HP. At the same time, restores Blade's HP by **25%** of his Max HP. After the Follow-Up ATK, all Charges are consumed.

entries.name: Karma Wind
entries.text:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering combat, consumes **20%** of Blade's Max HP while dealing Wind DMG equal to **40%** of his Max HP to all enemies.
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when this Technique is used.

entries.name: Vita Infinita
entries.text: When Blade's current HP percentage is at 50% of Max HP or lower, the HP restored when receiving healing increases by **20%**.

entries.name: Neverending Deaths
entries.text: If Blade hits a Weakness Broken enemy after using "Forest of Swords," he will restore HP equal to **5%** of his Max HP plus **100**.

entries.name: Cyclone of Destruction
entries.text: Increases DMG dealt by the Talent's Follow-Up ATK by **20%**.

entries.name: Blade Cuts the Deepest in Hell
entries.text:
Blade's Ultimate deals additionally increased DMG to one designated enemy target, with the increased amount equal to 150% of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle.
The tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at 90% of his Max HP. The tally value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.

entries.name: Ten Thousand Sorrows From One Broken Dream
entries.text: When Blade is in the Hellscape state, his CRIT Rate increases by 15%.

entries.name: Hardened Blade Bleeds Coldest Shade
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Rejected by Death, Infected With Life
entries.text: When Blade's current HP percentage drops to 50% or lower of his Max HP, increases his Max HP by 20%. Stacks up to 2 time(s).

entries.name: Death By Ten Lords' Gaze
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Reborn Into an Empty Husk
entries.text: The maximum number of Charge stacks is reduced to 4. The Follow-Up ATK triggered by Talent deals additionally increased DMG, with the increased amount equal to 50% of Blade's Max HP.
